d:
Finally, we've reached our 10th compilation! This time, the dubbed video is over 3 minutes long (simple plot, no subtitles, no NTR).

Making longer videos is quite tiring and time-consuming. I'll decide whether to make them more frequently depending on the situation.

Here are three preview clips and storyboard images; I can offer some suggestions.
Also, I probably won't be creating a new folder for GIFs anymore; they'll be in the existing folder. The new folder will mainly contain images of my work.

If you have some free time, please fill out the questionnaire; you'll receive a free copy of my work.
https://forms.gle/gAJ7Wa3jLoRMDTKB6

I make cosplay and general bishoujo videos. If you have any questions, please contact me through other platforms.
Support, sponsorships, and follow are welcome.
